brand.$description: Brand-hued text, readable on surfaces and brand tints in both modes (WCAG AA 4.5:1). A deeper shade of the brand colour where the brand colour itself is too light for text.

brand-secondary.$description: Deprecated in v2.16.3: use text/brand. Step 9 is the brand fill colour and is not readable as text for most accents. Removed in v2.18.

on-neutral-solid.$description: Text on background/neutral-primary-solid or neutral-secondary-solid (inverse surfaces).

brand.$description: Brand-hued icons (step 11 of the selected accent).

brand-secondary.$description: Deprecated in v2.16.3: use fg/brand. Step 9 is the brand fill colour and is not readable as text for most accents. Removed in v2.18.

on-neutral-solid.$description: Icon on background/neutral-primary-solid or neutral-secondary-solid (inverse surfaces).

overlay.$description: DEPRECATED v2.15: use overlay/scrim. Removed in v2.17.

surface.$description: DEPRECATED v2.15: in-page panels → surface/secondary; floating panels → overlay/primary. Removed in v2.17 after page retrofits.

panel.$description: DEPRECATED v2.15: rebind to surface/secondary or overlay/primary in the page retrofit. Removed in v2.17.

brand-faint.$description: Faintest brand wash (step 2 of the selected accent): page-section and large-area backgrounds that should read as a hint of the brand. One step lighter than background/brand-subtle (--my-bg-brand-subtle); cards on it use surface/primary or brand-subtle to separate.

brand-subtle.$description: Subtle brand tint (step 3 of the selected accent): selected rows, tags, subtle highlights. Not the brand colour itself; that is background/brand-solid (--my-bg-brand-solid).

brand-primary.$description: Deprecated in v2.16.3: renamed to background/brand-subtle. Same value. Removed in v2.18.

brand-soft.$description: Stronger brand tint (step 4 of the selected accent): soft buttons, hover on bg/brand-subtle.

brand-secondary.$description: Deprecated in v2.16.3: renamed to background/brand-soft. Same value. Removed in v2.18.

brand-solid.$description: Your brand colour: step 9 of the selected accent (Rebecca = #663399). Filled buttons and brand fills; put text/on-accent on it.

neutral-tertiary_hover.$description: Hover on a neutral-tertiary fill, or on surface/tertiary and overlay/secondary.

neutral-quaternary_hover.$description: Hover on a neutral-quaternary fill, or on overlay/tertiary.

neutral-primary-solid_hover.$description: Hover on background/neutral-primary-solid (inverse chips, Button Neutral Solid, inverse tooltip).

default.$description: DEPRECATED v2.15: use surface/primary. Removed in v2.17.

raised.$description: DEPRECATED v2.15: use surface/secondary. Removed in v2.17.

sunken.$description: Recessed well: inputs, code, inline expanded groups. Translucent, so it sinks relative to its parent tier.

overlay.$description: DEPRECATED v2.15: use overlay/primary. Removed in v2.17.

primary.$description: Tier 1: app canvas. Items on it hover with background/neutral-primary_hover.

secondary.$description: Tier 2: sidebar, card, panel on the canvas. Items hover with background/neutral-secondary_hover.

tertiary.$description: Tier 3: container nested in a tier-2 container. Items hover with background/neutral-tertiary_hover (never secondary_hover: it equals this fill).

primary.$description: Floating panel on the page: menu, popover, tooltip, dialog, drawer. Items hover with background/neutral-secondary_hover.

secondary.$description: Floating panel opened from inside another overlay: submenu, popover in a dialog. Items hover with background/neutral-tertiary_hover.

tertiary.$description: Third-level floating panel. Items hover with background/neutral-quaternary_hover.
